conclusions: The city approved 30-day retention for captured Flock LPR data.
findings: The city approved 30-day retention for captured Flock LPR data.
The 2026 audit reportedly examined activity dating to November 2023, implying search logs or exported audit records persist separately from captured plate data.
Public records do not clearly distinguish retention for plate observations, searches, alerts, audit logs, exports, case attachments, and legal holds.
limitations: Publicly available records may omit internal policy, technical configuration, or later changes.
data.method: Compared the approved retention schedule with the longer retrospective audit period and Flock's logging claims.
